// Card API devuelve array → n8n lo divide en items individuales
const rows = $input.all().map(item => item.json);
const updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
const out = rows
  .map(row => ({
    bia_code:                    row.codigo_bia,
    contract_id:                 row.contract_id,
    frontier_name:               row.nombre_frontera,
    grid_operator:               row.operador_de_red,
    measurement_type:            row.tipo_de_medida,
    market_type:                 row.tipo_de_mercado,
    current_phase:               row.fase_actual,
    city:                        row.ciudad,
    department:                  row.departamento,
    kwh_per_month:               row.kwh_mes,
    scheduled_date:              row.fecha_programada,
    successful_install_date:     row.fecha_inst_exitosa,
    contract_sign_date:          row.fecha_firma_del_contrato,
    estimated_vipe_cost:         row.costo_est_visita_previa,
    estimated_install_cost_adj:  row.costo_est_instalacion_ajustado,
    estimated_legalization_cost: row.costo_est_legalizacion,
    total_estimated_visit_cost:  row.costo_total_estimado_visitas,
    estimated_opex_cost:         row.costo_opex_estimado,
    sales_opex_cost:             row.costo_opex_sales,
    sales_payback_months:        row.payback_sales,
    opex_delta:                  row.delta_opex,
    delta_traffic_light:         row.semaforo_delta,
    recommendation_band:         row.banda,
    cac_per_kwh:                 row.cac_kwh,
    net_aging_days:              row.aging_neto_dias,
    updated_at
  }))
  .filter(o => o.bia_code != null && String(o.bia_code).trim() !== '');
console.log('Transform backlog: ' + rows.length + ' rows recibidas, ' + out.length + ' válidas tras filtro bia_code');
if (!out.length) return [{ json: { _skip: true, count: 0 } }];
return out.map(o => ({ json: o }));
